name: @dewbow/workspace
description: Dewbow Core and Team services, Web clients, and shared libraries

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-sdk && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/team-protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/team-protocol && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/tests/team-core.test.mjs
scripts.core:host-daemon: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-sdk && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-host-daemon && npm run start --workspace @dewbow/core-host-daemon --
scripts.core:control-plane: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-control-plane && npm run start --workspace @dewbow/core-control-plane --
scripts.team:backend: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/core-protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/team-protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/team-backend && npm run start --workspace @dewbow/team-backend --
